title: Tests: green, failures now go to module logs

owner_note.text: All 120 node tests pass. The 28 reds were: the Agent SDK missing in worktrees (the runner now falls back to the main checkout's copy, nothing linked), a task_key bug for session paths, and a stale Append test (strings are refused by design). WorktreeWatch waits 45 s of no saves, then appends a line to failures.jsonl in the failing module's folder (main checkout, git-ignored) and sends nothing to the agent; the builder follows the module. A test proves the debounce. Basic tests: new for Test, Process and Item; the other core classes already had one. Decision: keep X.test.mjs, not X.node.tests.js (the runner and 120 files use it). ai/errors/ stays for ErrorLog readers; new failures go per module. TasksPage.test, Template.test and whisper-detach are load-sensitive (pass alone). Servex restart pending.
